lead_html: E Amara 20 is an E minor pan with a big range. Start with the chords on the top shell, then add the bottom notes when you want more depth.
alias_html: Sold as "E Amara 20 (13+7)": 13 top notes and 7 bottom notes.
history_html: E Amara 20 is an E minor layout with 20 notes. One maker's listing gives E3 on the ding, 12 more notes on the top shell (B3 D4 E4 F#4 G4 A4 B4 D5 E5 F#5 G5 A5) and 7 bottom notes (C3 D3 F#3 G3 A3 C4 C5).
og_description: E Amara 20 handpan chords: chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
